nodes.label: Iron Laws
nodes.rationale: Three capability denials (no completion claim without fresh evidence; no fix without proven root cause; no irreversible action without human approval). Framed as denials, not advice, so the letter equals the spirit; the only escape valve is a user message in the current conversation about this task — standing instructions and config never qualify.

nodes.label: Step 0 First-Action Protocol
nodes.rationale: Classify -> tier -> load module -> record todo entry -> announce one line, before any response. Todo entry is the durable state that survives context compaction; the tripwire retroactively voids a skipped Step 0 the moment a mutation or status claim is attempted.

nodes.label: Risk Tier System (T1/T2/T3)
nodes.rationale: Mechanical signals only (domain markers, file/LOC magnitude, irreversibility) — never 'feels risky'. Re-tier is upward-only on observable triggers (6th file, >300 LOC diff, >5 callers, irreversible op surfacing); de-escalation requires an explicit user message. Cosmetic-marker false positives may hold T1 but must be voiced — silence is a violation (rule hardened after A/B v1 S7 showed silent under-tiering).

nodes.label: Completion Gate
nodes.rationale: Name the proving command, predict its outcome, run fresh, read full output, paste lines, then claim with a typed status. Evidence expires at the message boundary and any later mutation invalidates it; missing verification forces BLOCKED, never a 'concern' (anti-laundering norm). Includes the claim->evidence table with a Not-Sufficient column.

nodes.label: Typed Status Tokens
nodes.rationale: DONE | DONE_WITH_CONCERNS | BLOCKED | NEEDS_CONTEXT. English tokens kept inside Russian reports as machine-checkable anchors; BLOCKED and NEEDS_CONTEXT are first-class outcomes so honest stopping is a completable turn.

nodes.label: In-Task Circuit Breakers
nodes.rationale: 3 failed pre-registered fix attempts -> stop and question the frame (a wrong frame, not a failed hypothesis); 2 failed skeptic rounds -> STOP + BLOCKED; a command failing twice with the same error -> read full output and change approach. Counters live in the Step 0 todo entry.

nodes.label: Pressure Inoculation
nodes.rationale: Time pressure, authority and sunk cost raise the stakes, so gates apply MORE strictly. 'Too simple to check', 'just this once', 'should work now', 'I'll verify at the end' are four shapes of one skipped gate — each is a hypothesis that must be run.

nodes.label: Module Manifest (MODULES)
nodes.rationale: One trigger-plus-temptation line per playbook, zero procedure, resolved against the __CONDUCTOR_DIR__ base. The placeholder base replaced a hardcoded author-machine path after the A/B v2 bench exposed playbook loads failing on any other machine layout.
